description: This file contains a utility class 'AudioUtils' with static methods for reading audio data from an Android AudioRecord object. It includes methods for reading a specified duration of audio into a buffer, with logging and tracing for debugging and performance measurement.

classes.name: AudioUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for reading audio data from an AudioRecord object, including functionality to read for a specified duration with logging and tracing.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads audio data from the given AudioRecord instance into a buffer for a specified duration, with internal looping until the duration is met or reading stops due to an error.
